expectations.text: Contains 90–130 words in exactly two paragraphs, with no bullets, hashtags, or emoji.
expectations.evidence: The invitation has 108 whitespace-delimited words and exactly two paragraphs. It begins "Citizens" and the second paragraph begins "Admission"; there are no bullets, hashtags or emoji.

expectations.text: Includes the exact phrase Citizens of the stapled republic and exactly one rhetorical question, retaining a warm mock-grandiose town-crier voice.
expectations.evidence: Exact phrase: "Citizens of the stapled republic". Its only question is "What kingdom could offer greater riches than a roomful of small, unruly pages?" "hear the proclamation", "worthy contribution", and "dear neighbors" sustain the warm theatrical voice.

expectations.text: Accurately states Saturday, 17 May, 2–4 p.m. at Moss Street Library in the upstairs room, with free admission and all ages welcome.
expectations.evidence: "On Saturday, 17 May, from 2–4 p.m., Moss Street Library summons you to its upstairs room"; "Admission is free, and all ages are welcome."

expectations.text: Says guests may bring up to five zines to trade or come empty-handed to browse; does not imply that bringing zines is required.
expectations.evidence: "Bring up to five zines to trade, or come empty-handed to browse. Your presence alone is a worthy contribution" makes bringing zines expressly optional.

expectations.text: Clearly states that upstairs access is by stairs only and that a small selection can be browsed at the ground-floor desk; neither access statement is presented as a joke or as a full equivalent of the upstairs event.
expectations.evidence: "The upstairs room has stair access only. A small selection is available for browsing at the ground-floor desk." These are plain standalone sentences and describe only a small selection, not an equivalent downstairs event.

expectations.text: Does not invent refreshments, prizes, registration, a year, or an accessible route upstairs.
expectations.evidence: No refreshments, prizes, registration, year or accessible upstairs route is mentioned. The access fact remains "stair access only."
